tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: Get the system UI theme. Returns "light" or "dark".

tools.name: set_theme
tools.description: Set the system UI theme (light or dark mode). NOTE: this updates the stored setting immediately, but the HOME menu only re-reads it when it reloads - so the visible change takes effect after sleep/wake or a reboot, not instantly.

tools.name: get_nickname
tools.description: Get the console's device nickname (the name shown on the network and in settings).

tools.name: get_brightness
tools.description: Get the current screen brightness as a value from 0.0 (dimmest) to 1.0 (brightest).

tools.name: set_brightness
tools.description: Set the screen brightness and apply it immediately. Note: if the console has auto-brightness enabled it may adjust again on its own.

tools.name: get_volume
tools.description: Get the current master volume as a value from 0.0 (muted) to 1.0 (max).

tools.name: airplane_mode
tools.description: Enable airplane mode (disable all wireless). WARNING: this disconnects the console from the network, so the server becomes unreachable immediately and CANNOT be re-enabled remotely - a human must turn wireless back on from the console. There is no remote 'disable airplane mode' for that reason. Only use when explicitly asked to.

tools.name: get_auto_time
tools.description: Get whether the clock is automatically synchronized over the internet. Returns "enabled" or "disabled".

tools.name: set_auto_time
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic internet clock synchronization. Disable it before setting the clock manually with set_datetime, or the manual time is overwritten.

tools.name: get_datetime
tools.description: Get the console's current local date, time, and timezone. Returns "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <timezone>".

tools.name: set_datetime
tools.description: Set the console's clock. Provide any subset of date/time fields; omitted ones keep their current value. The time is interpreted in the console's current timezone. (The timezone itself can't be changed remotely; set the date/time only.) If internet time sync is on, the OS may later re-sync - call set_auto_time(false) first to make a manual time stick.
